mapper.select: SELECT fb.id, fb.question_id AS questionId, q.title AS questionTitle, fb.user_id AS userId, u.student_id AS studentId, u.full_name AS fullName, fb.contest_user_id AS contestUserId, fb.bonus_points AS bonusPoints, fb.achieved_at AS achievedAt FROM first_bloods fb LEFT JOIN questions q ON fb.question_id = q.id LEFT JOIN users u ON fb.user_id = u.id ORDER BY fb.achieved_at ASC

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.points AS basePoints, COALESCE(s.correct_count, 0) AS correctCount FROM questions q LEFT JOIN ( SELECT question_id, COUNT(*) AS correct_count FROM submissions WHERE is_correct = TRUE GROUP BY question_id ) s ON s.question_id = q.id WHERE q.is_active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO first_bloods (question_id, user_id, contest_user_id, bonus_points) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{userId}, #{contestUserId}, #{bonusPoints})
